# HAZWOPER Answers

> 24 straight answers to the most common HAZWOPER questions: 40 vs 24-hour, online training, refreshers, certificates, PPE levels and more. Searchable.

HAZWOPER Answers (https://hazwoper-faq.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, 24-Hour HAZWOPER, 8-Hour Refresher, 40-Hour (Spanish) or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://hazwoper-faq.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).
